subject: website
name: API3 DAO
summary: The API3 DAO staking and voting dashboard, now with a notice that governance has moved to Snapshot. Its source is public (no licence file). It is not Level 3: when it opens, its wallet library loads the WalletConnect/Web3Modal wallet list, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also embeds a YouTube video and loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: Web3Modal wallet list (api.web3modal.com)
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.

connections.name: YouTube embed (youtube-nocookie.com)
connections.note: A visible player on the page, loaded as the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
